create_spanbert_task: create a SpanBertTask to train a BERT model with span masking on a data directory
build_bert_dictionary: build a BertDictionary with cls, mask, and sep symbols for BERT-style tokenization
load_spanbert_dataset: load a SpanBertDataset from indexed or raw text data with configurable span masking schemes
configure_span_masking: configure span masking with geometric distribution, span bounds, and mask ratio parameters
setup_spanbert_training: setup a span BERT training task with no-NSP mode, shuffle, and tag bitmap support
